# scripts/AISystem/Temperament.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/AISystem/Temperament.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Rolls nerve, drive and guile (0..1) from archetype baselines and presets.
Squad uses absolute values for resolve/roles; GuardFighter uses deviations from
its archetype. Tags select dialogue and stance. Names are deterministic by seed;
Guard resolves name collisions within the level.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.
